name: 运动后清爽补水电解质风味水款
description: 白底整箱加单瓶双主图，运动补水场景与空白参数信息图，突出清爽冷感

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white studio stage #FFFFFF for packshots, alternating with flat fruit-green fields #4CA30C, open sky #2E6FB8, raw concrete #B9B4AD and pale condensation grounds #F1F3F2
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool neutral high-key studio light, large front-left softbox key with a fill card, thin sweeping rim on bottle caps, soft contact shadows, never harsh or dramatic
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless cyclorama and light stone ledges #E7E9E6, always cold and lightly beaded with condensation
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, headline plus two short labels maximum, all wording carried by placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs in fruit-green #4CA30C, outline only, no letters, no digits, no medical or certification symbols
styleLock.presentationRules: bottle kept upright, cold and condensation-beaded with a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle and constant scale across the set; every printed panel, badge and table stays blank
noDrift: no printed numbers, units or nutrition values anywhere
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean cold sports-hydration beverage visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white stage #FFFFFF, fresh fruit-green accent #4CA30C, cool condensation grey-blue #DCE5E9 and charcoal text #33383D; cool neutral high-key studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, fill card, thin sweeping rim and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif in one family; thin single-weight line icons only in the accent colour; bottled beverage always crisp, chilled and beaded with condensation, held at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle with constant scale; every carton panel, badge, table cell and seal stays blank and unprinted; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

Straight-on eye-level composition: the sealed carton sits at the left rear with one upright bottle shown large at the right foreground, both full products visible and never clipped. provenance.notes: 逐图事实：图1 白底上整箱外箱与一瓶放大侧影同框，箱面印有件数、单瓶容量与糖分标注等数值型字样；图2 浅灰水珠底，左侧竖向口味色带、上部三枚圆形线性图标、中部营养成分表数值双栏与下方配料段落；图3 纯绿底左侧单瓶、右侧超大件数数字与口味名两行；图4 蓝天底运动员颈搭毛巾、手持瓶身、顶部两行英文标题；图5 清水混凝土墙前运动员仰头饮用、顶部三行英文标题、瓶身为另一果味色带（仅作可替换色带处理）。品类判定：图示为即饮瓶装电解质风味饮料，有整箱瓶装形态与冲饮场景，非冲调粉剂、非生鲜果蔬、亦非医药保健营养补充剂，故判食品饮料/饮料，与提示类目一致。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与系列名、包装装潢配色条与口味名称、箱面件数与单瓶容量数字、营养成分表全部数值与百分比、配料文字、热量与糖分及维生素类全部数值型与功效型主张（一律改为空参数行、空白单元格、空白印章框与占位符）、顶部英文标题原句、两位可辨识运动员的面容与身份（改为无面部或面部被瓶身遮挡的通用成人模特）、整箱与图内一切徽标与角标；产品在所有分镜中均以 {product} 占位。
